admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.audit.intro: Every admin, security and data action in this workspace. Entries cannot be edited or deleted, and are kept for 7 years.
admin.audit.ip.notShown.why: IP addresses are personal data. “Not shown” means this column is not available to you; it does not tell you whether an address was recorded.
admin.audit.empty.title: No events match these filters
admin.audit.empty.body: Try a longer date range or remove a filter. Events older than 7 years are no longer kept.
admin.audit.export.title: Export the audit log
admin.audit.export.body: We email a link to your own address and to nobody else’s.
admin.audit.export.format.json.note: Keeps the before and after detail
admin.audit.export.scope.filtered.note: Only the events you can see right now
admin.audit.export.scope.last_90_days.no: Everything from the last 90 days that you can see
admin.audit.export.ip.note: Off by default. IP addresses are personal data, and turning this on is recorded.
admin.audit.export.audited: This export is itself recorded in the audit log.
admin.audit.export.queued: We will email a link to {hint}. It expires after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
admin.audit.export.queued.noHint: We will email a link to the address on your account.
admin.scripts.intro: Agents see the script for the channel and language of each interaction. A WhatsApp script must match a template the provider has approved.
admin.scripts.col.name: Script
admin.scripts.empty.title: No scripts yet
admin.scripts.empty.body: Scripts are written in the script builder. None have been added to this programme.
admin.ret.notice: These rules override the workspace default of {days}. Check the client contract and any sector rules before shortening a period. General guidance, not legal advice.
admin.ret.notice.noDefault: Check the client contract and any sector rules before shortening a period. General guidance, not legal advice.
admin.ret.unset.title: No retention rules saved yet
admin.ret.unset.body: This programme has no retention rules of its own. Choose a period for each kind of record and what happens at the end, then save.
admin.ret.scope.note: These are the rules recorded for this programme. Call recordings held by the telephony platform follow that platform’s own retention rule until the two are joined up, so shortening the period here does not delete the audio on its own.
admin.ret.row.recordings.note: Audio of every inbound and outbound call.
admin.ret.row.transcripts.note: WhatsApp, SMS and email threads, with attachments.
admin.ret.row.screen.note: Agent desktop captures used for QA.
admin.ret.onExpiry.delete.note: Files and text are erased from storage and backups within 30 days.
admin.ret.onExpiry.anonymise.note: Names, numbers and identifiers are removed. Counts and scores stay for reporting.
admin.ret.redact: Redact card numbers, BVN and NIN in transcripts
admin.ret.redact.note: Replaced before storage. Recordings pause while agents take card details.
admin.ret.hold.note: Stops all deletion for this programme until you turn it off. Use only when the client or a regulator asks.

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.subtitle: Free for 14 days. No card needed.
signup.fullName.label: Full name
signup.email.label: Work email
signup.email.help: Use your company email so your team can find you.
signup.phone.label: Mobile number
signup.phone.help: We'll text a code to check it. The number starts with {dial} — change the country code if that is wrong.
signup.company.label: Company name
signup.country.label: Country
signup.password.label: Password
signup.password.help: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
signup.bpo.title: Are you a BPO or contact centre?
signup.bpo.on: Yes — we'll turn on queues, agent status and wrap-up codes.
signup.bpo.off: No — you'll start with a simple shared inbox. Turn queues on any time.
signup.terms: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and the Privacy notice.
signup.invalid.email: Type a work email, like you@company.com.
verify.title: Check your email and phone
verify.subtitle: We need both so we can reach you if something goes wrong with your account.
verify.email.waiting: Open the link we emailed you
verify.phone.title: Enter the code we texted you
verify.emailPending: Your phone is confirmed. Open the link in the email we sent, then come back and continue.
verify.help: Can't find the email? Check spam or Promotions. It comes from no-reply@kasuwa.africa.
verify.missing: This page is missing the details of your sign-up. Start again and we'll send new codes.
region.title: Where should we store your data?
region.subtitle: This is where your contacts, chats and call recordings live. Moving it later needs a planned migration.
region.za.name: South Africa · Johannesburg
region.za.desc: Included in every plan. Fast for most of Africa.
region.ng.name: Nigeria · Lagos
region.ng.desc: Keeps data inside Nigeria. For banks, fintechs and government work.
region.ke.name: Kenya · Nairobi
region.ke.desc: Best for teams mostly in East Africa.
region.sales.note: Our sales team sets this region up with you. It cannot be chosen during sign-up.
region.law.title: What Nigeria's data law (NDPA 2023) means for you
region.law.guidance: You can usually keep Nigerian customers' data outside Nigeria if it stays well protected and you tell customers where it goes. Kasuwa signs a data processing agreement with you and never sells your data. If you're a bank, fintech or work with government, your regulator may ask for data in Nigeria.
region.law.sales: Nigerian data residency is set up with our sales team.
currency.title: Currency and language
currency.subtitle: These are your workspace defaults. Each deal can still use its own currency.
currency.teamLanguage.help: Each person can change their own.
currency.customerLanguages.help: Used for message templates and routing chats to agents who speak the language.
whatsapp.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.subtitle: Chat with customers where they already are. It takes about 5 minutes on Meta's secure page.
whatsapp.need.title: You'll need
whatsapp.need.number: A phone number that isn't already using the WhatsApp app
whatsapp.need.meta: A Meta Business account — you can create one during setup
whatsapp.need.registration: Your business registration (e.g. CAC certificate) for verification
whatsapp.connect.note: Opens a Meta window. Kasuwa never sees your Facebook password.
whatsapp.connect.unavailable: Connecting WhatsApp is not ready yet. Skip this step for now — you can connect later from Settings.
whatsapp.window.title: The 24-hour window
whatsapp.window.body: When a customer messages you, you can reply freely for 24 hours. After that, you can only send pre-approved template messages until they write again.
whatsapp.cost.title: What messages cost
whatsapp.cost.note: Meta sets prices per country and changes them from time to time. We charge Meta's price with no markup and show live rates in Billing.
import.title: Bring your contacts and deals
import.subtitle: We copy your data. Nothing changes in your old tool.
import.crm.body: Sign in to {name} and choose what to bring: contacts, companies, deals and notes. Big accounts can take a few hours — we'll email you when it's done.
import.crm.unavailable: Connecting {name} is not ready yet. You can bring a CSV file instead, or skip this step for now.
import.csv.help: Excel files: save as CSV first. Only the column names are read on this page.
import.csv.unreadable: We could not read that file. Save it as CSV and try again.
import.startFresh: Nothing to import? Start fresh. You can import any time from Settings → Data.
invite.title: Invite your team
invite.subtitle: Add the people who'll answer chats and calls. You can change roles later.
invite.emails.label: Email addresses
invite.emails.help: Paste many at once — separate with commas or new lines.
invite.emails.missingEnding: “{address}” is missing an ending like .ng or .com.
invite.link.body: Share a link in your team's WhatsApp group. People who join are added as Agents and wait for your approval.
invite.link.unavailable: Invite links are not ready yet. Invite by email for now.
invite.empty.title: No one invited yet
invite.empty.body: That's fine — you can invite people any time from Settings → Team.
done.title: Your workspace is ready
done.subtitle: Here's what's done and what's left. This list stays on your Home page.
done.item.region.detail: Set when the workspace was created.
done.item.whatsapp.detail: Reply to customers on the app they use every day.
done.item.import.todo.detail: From Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot or a CSV file.
done.item.team.none: No one on the list yet.
